# `silk/target`

<!-- Generated by packages/compiler/scripts/generate-documentation.mjs. Do not edit by hand. -->

Compile-time nominal facts for the selected compilation target.

## Details

[`profile`](#declaration-73696c6b2f7461726765743a3a70726f66696c65) identifies
the complete target profile, while [`arch`](#declaration-73696c6b2f7461726765743a3a61726368) groups profiles by instruction-set architecture.
The integer facts are derived from that profile during static evaluation and have no runtime
storage.

Import as `Target` with `import silk.target { Target }`.

Public declarations: 8.

<a id="declaration-73696c6b2f7461726765743a3a50726f66696c65"></a>
